description:
Cast Adrix and Nev by paying its mana cost.
When Adrix and Nev enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Adrix and Nev with haste plus at least one additional token due to Adrix and Nev's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Esika to tap one of the Adrix and Nev tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Adrix and Nev.
Holding priority, use the ability of Esika to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
